description: Get one Korean tax interpretation by the National Tax Service or the Ministry of Economy and Finance from the NTS tax law information system (국세법령정보시스템): summary, body (facts, question, reply) and related laws. id is the document ID (문서ID) from search_tax_interpretation results, or the original link. Read a long document by page (15,000 characters each). An interpretation answers an individual question and is not binding like law.

id.description: Document ID (18 digits) or a https://taxlaw.nts.go.kr/…ntstDcmId=… link

name: get_tax_interpretation
title: Get tax interpretation (세법 해석 보기)
